hypotheses.F1_variables_are_reused_across_functions: The median human source variable has effective support of at least four layer-head functions.
hypotheses.F2_functions_are_reused_across_variables: The median selected layer-head function reads at least five human source variables.
hypotheses.F3_same_variable_uses_distinct_transform: Median absolute OV cosine between functions reading the same variable is below 0.20.
hypotheses.F4_routing_similarity_predicts_transform: Spearman correlation between route-profile cosine and absolute OV cosine is at least 0.20.
hypotheses.F5_native_head_modes_are_lexically_reada: Median lexical-category purity of decoded leading OV mode poles exceeds the uniform-vocabulary random p95 by 0.10.
